Catholic Life
Newsletters
Welcome to St. Aloysius' Catholic Primary School
I am extremely proud to be the Headteacher of St. Aloysius' Catholic Primary School, where all our pupils are 'ambitious for the higher gifts'. Our school is built upon the ethos 'To know. To love. To serve.' Here at St. Aloysius', staff are committed to develop pupils' knowledge, relationships, and awareness of the world around them. We welcome children from a range of faiths and backgrounds - with almost 40 different home languages spoken - and we foster strong community links. A quote from a child during our recent OFSTED inspection was 'No one feels left out here. We are like a family and look after each other.' Hannah Tebb | Headteacher

pageCache.text:
Special Educational Needs (SEND) at St Aloysius School
At St. Aloysius' Catholic Primary, we are dedicated to providing an inclusive and supportive environment that caters to the varied educational needs of all our students. We work closely with parents, caregivers, and specialist services to ensure we meet the specific needs of each child, helping them to achieve their full potential.
Our SEND team is committed to upholding the highest standards of education and pastoral care. We offer a range of interventions and support mechanisms, including Individual Education Plans (IEPs), which are regularly reviewed and updated in partnership with parents. This collaborative approach ensures that we are responsive to the changing needs of our students as they progress through their primary education at St. Aloysius'.
We encourage parents to engage actively with our SEND team. Communication is key to the success of our students, and we value the insights and feedback that parents can provide. Whether you are considering St. Aloysius' for your child's education or are a current parent with queries about our SEND provision, please do not hesitate to get in touch.
Please see the school’s SEND policy for more details.Please also see the latest SEND information reportYou can contact our school SENCO directly by email on: senco@st-aloysius.oxon.sch.uk
This provision supports the local offer of Oxfordshire County Council: https://www.oxfordshire.gov.uk/cms/public-site/special-educational-needs-and-disability-local-offer. If you would like to provide feedback, including compliments and complaints about SEND provision, please email the school: admin.3842@st-aloysius.oxon.sch.uk

pageCache.text:
Sports Premium and PE
At St. Aloysius' Catholic Primary, we are committed to promoting the health and well-being of our pupils through a dynamic PhysicalEducation (PE) programme, supported by the Sports Premium funding. This enables us to enhance our sports offerings and ensure all pupils benefit from high-quality PE lessons and extracurricular activities. Our goal is to foster a love of sport and physical activity, helping children develop healthy habits that will last a lifetime.
The Sports Premium funding is a vital resource that allows us to invest in physical education. We believe that through active participation in sports, our students gain important life skills such as teamwork, leadership, and perseverance.
